abort.no_unconfigured_devices: No unconfigured fireplaces found. Make sure the fireplace is powered on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

data_description.aux: Select if you want to control the AUX relay on your fireplace
data_description.blower: Select if your fireplace has a blower fan
data_description.led_lights: Select if your fireplace has the LED light kit
data_description.night_light: The light mounted at the top inside the firebox
data_description.split_flow: Select if your fireplace has a primary and secondary burner (eg. front/back)

select_features.description: Select the features your fireplace is equipped with

user.description: Select your fireplace and enter the password. The default password is '0000'.

data_description.address: The fireplace's Bluetooth controller. It advertises a name starting with NAP_FPC_.
data_description.password: The password set in the eFIRE app. Unless it was changed, it is 0000.

data_description.led_lights: The LED light kit, if one is fitted. Untick this if the LED controls appear to do nothing

init.description: Change the features your fireplace is equipped with. Entities for features you untick will stop being provided.
